items.source: By default this is set to Integer.MAX_VALUE.
Create a new TaskExecutorRegistration for a default ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 为默认的ThreadPoolTaskExecutor创建一个新的TaskExecutorRegistration。

items.source: Create a new TaskExecutorRegistration for a given ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 为给定的ThreadPoolTaskExecutor创建一个新的TaskExecutorRegistration。

items.source: NOTE: The core pool size is effectively the max pool size when an unbounded queueCapacity is configured (the default). This is essentially the "Unbounded queues" strategy as explained in ThreadPoolExecutor. When this strategy is used, the maxPoolSize is ignored.
items.translation: 注意： 当配置了无限制的queueCapacity（默认值）时，核心线程池大小实际上等同于最大线程池大小。这本质上就是ThreadPoolExecutor中所述的“无限制队列”策略。使用此策略时，maxPoolSize将被忽略。

items.source: NOTE: when an unbounded queueCapacity is configured (the default), the core pool size is effectively the max pool size. This is essentially the "Unbounded queues" strategy as explained in ThreadPoolExecutor. When this strategy is used, the maxPoolSize is ignored.
items.translation: 注意：当配置无界 queueCapacity（默认值）时，核心线程池大小实际上等同于最大线程池大小。这本质上就是ThreadPoolExecutor中所述的“无界队列”策略。使用此策略时，maxPoolSize将被忽略。

items.source: NOTE: When an unbounded queueCapacity is configured (the default), the max pool size is effectively ignored. See the "Unbounded queues" strategy in ThreadPoolExecutor for more details.
items.translation: 注意： 当配置无界队列（默认设置）时，最大线程池大小实际上会被忽略。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 ThreadPoolExecutor 中的“无界队列”策略。

items.source: By default this is set to twice the value of Runtime.availableProcessors(). In an application where tasks do not block frequently, the number should be closer to or equal to the number of available CPUs/cores.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为Runtime.availableProcessors()的两倍。在任务不经常阻塞的应用程序中，该数值应接近或等于可用的 CPU/核心数。

items.source: By default this is set to 60.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 60。

items.source: Specify if the task executor has been supplied.
items.translation: 指定是否已提供任务执行器。

items.source: true if the task executor was provided, false if it has been created internally
items.translation: 如果任务执行器已提供，则为 `true`；如果已在内部创建，则为 `false`。

items.source: A registration class for customizing the properties of ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 用于自定义ThreadPoolTaskExecutor属性的注册类。

items.source: Set the core pool size of the ThreadPoolExecutor.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的核心线程池大小。

items.source: Set the time limit for which threads may remain idle before being terminated.
items.translation: 设置线程在空闲后被终止前的时间限制。

items.source: Set the max pool size of the ThreadPoolExecutor.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的最大线程池大小。

items.source: Set the queue capacity for the ThreadPoolExecutor.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的队列容量。
